summary: Practise manager evidence reviews, mandate-fit analysis, and investment committee reporting. Explore this five-day pension fund course.
lede: Investment due diligence for pension funds is the structured review of external managers, strategies and vehicles before and after appointment. For pension investment officers, manager research analysts and investment committee secretariats, it supports documented selection and monitoring decisions against fund objectives. Learners practise testing mandate fit, reconciling performance and cash-flow evidence, reviewing valuation assumptions and controls, and turning unresolved issues into committee recommendations and follow-up actions.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course suits professionals who assess, recommend, approve, or monitor external investment managers and private-market vehicles. It is designed for roles that need to turn manager information into documented pension investment decisions.
prerequisites: Working knowledge of pension investment mandates, investment manager reports, or portfolio review is expected. No programming is required. For Excel exercises, bring a laptop with Excel available; no specialist software or personal platform account is required.
